newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank market rates close higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank market rates close higher.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market rates closed higher on Tuesday owing to a paucity of funds at the year-end, dealers said.
The traditional crunch usually witnessed on the last working day of the year was present from the start of trading hours, a dealer at Khadim Ali Shah Bukhari and Co Ltd said.
"Some commercial banks covered their positions at as high as 28 percent," the dealer said. It was near the end of the trading hours that funds were available between 25 and 23 percent.
